verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is fundamentally an API product. The docs cover a single unified endpoint with a normalized schema (openrouter-docs-1, openrouter-docs-39), streaming, tool calling, routing parameters, a models listing endpoint and programmatic key management (openrouter-docs-11, openrouter-docs-5, openrouter-docs-21, openrouter-docs-35, openrouter-docs-8). A probe confirms a live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt (openrouter-probe-3, openrouter-probe-1), and community users independently praise driving it through the same API key and requests in production, including key minting (openrouter-comm-2, openrouter-comm-12).
